title: Large Groups! 6Bed/3Bath Near Opry & Broadway!
description:
Stay at Nashville Nights, a spacious 6-bedroom, 3-bath vacation rental perfect for large groups, family trips, bachelor and bachelorette parties, and weekend getaways. Conveniently located near Downtown Nashville, Broadway, East Nashville, and the Grand Ole Opry. Enjoy comfortable beds, modern finishes, a game room, oversized communal balcony, and quick highway access. Experience the best of Music City while staying in a safe, comfortable, and centrally located home.

The space
6 Bed/3 bath

- 1 King Bed
- 1 Queen Bed
- 2 Full BunkBeds

Guest access
Entire Condo.

Game Room and Rooftop Balcony on 4th floor

Other things to note
1 reserved Parking space -   Phelps #106

Additional Parking: Unmarked spaces in the Point East Office Complex lot across the street (Friday 5pm - Sunday 10am, and holiday nights) Also on the side of the building there are 3 guest parking spots on the street side. 

The Primary Bedroom closest is locked and used for storage for the cleaning crew.
